name: Place
author: Spu7Nix
description: Fall up after entering the cube portal at 1.1% to enter the wave portal at 1.8%. Navigate through the gameplay as the wave (including a very difficult part from 12%-13%) and make sure to get the normal gravity portal at 13%. Navigate through the gameplay as the wave without touching any portals until 59% where you can enter the ship portal slightly above the floor. Navigate through the following gameplay as the ship until 70% where you can enter the cube portal in the middle of the screen. Don’t jump off the platform at 71% and instead buffer a hold while falling off and continue holding until you enter the UFO portal. Play through the decode wave at 72% and then hold to the ceiling as the ship until you pass the first black orb in the letter “K” where you can then release. Buffer a jump after entering the cube portal at 76% and then time the red orb at 76.9% to avoid the reverse gravity portal and mini portal but still make it into the UFO portal. Navigate through the gameplay as the UFO until 78% where you can enter the cube portal and then buffer a jump, the pink orb and the dash orb above the portal. Release from the dash orb when you're about to touch the wave portal at 79% and then buffer a hold to make it to the ceiling and continue holding until 80% where you enter the ship portal. Enter the wave portal before the blue pad at 80.7% and then time a hold around 81.17% to enter the normal size portal and to play the following section as the wave. Navigate through the gameplay as the wave until 88% where you can enter the wave portal on the floor. Enter the cube portal at 89.3%. Jump over the blue pad at 90.3% and hit the blue pad at 90.7%. Navigate through the gameplay as the cube until 93.1% where you can jump off the block to enter a ship portal. Play through the gameplay while taking the routes near the floor until 95% where you can hold the dash orb until you make it to the red orb where you can then release, click the red orb next to the block at 95.8%, click the yellow and black orb and then release until you make it back to the floor. Continue playing through the gameplay on the floor for the rest of the level.
